description: Free. Newest-first feed of permissioned-domain ledger activity: XLS-70/80 domain and credential lifecycle, XLS-81 permissioned-DEX offers and AMM ops, and Payments made inside a domain. Consecutive same-account quote runs are collapsed into one row with a count, because a market maker replacing its own offers as the reference price moves is one behaviour, not hundreds of events - that churn is ~94% of raw permissioned-DEX volume and is normal market making, not an anomaly. Filter with category=lifecycle to see only domain and credential changes, which are the rare institutional signal. Carries a rollup of the whole window so the churn is visible as a proportion.
